learn.title: Learn
learn.lede: When a change hiro ships does something this codebase never did before, hiro explains it here: what it is, why the change needed it, where to look, and a short quiz.
learn.none: No lessons yet. When hiro pushes a change that does something new for its repository, the lesson appears here.
learn.noneNew: You're up to date: every lesson is marked learned.
learn.quizCount: {n, plural, one {# quiz question} other {# quiz questions}}
learn.whereSub: Files in {repo} at the time of {key}.
learn.quizSub: Pick an answer to see whether it's right.
learn.readingNote: Claude suggested these links. Check them before relying on them.
learn.ticketSub: Techniques this change brought to the repository for the first time.
learn.ticketPending: hiro is reading this change for anything the repository never did before.
learn.ticketNone: Nothing new: this change only used techniques the repository already had.
learn.ticketFailed: hiro could not finish reading this change. The log shows why.
learn.ticketIdle: hiro has not looked at this change for lessons yet.
learn.queued: Queued: hiro will look at this change for something new.
learn.queueSub: Pushed tickets hiro reads for new techniques, one at a time when no ticket needs a worker.
learn.queuedAll: {n, plural, one {# ticket queued} other {# tickets queued}}
learn.queueLede: Pushed tickets hiro reads for techniques the codebase never used before. Queue any done ticket, or retry one that failed.
learn.queueEmpty: Nothing to learn from right now: every pushed ticket has been read.
